Inventory Master: ready-to-use Power Apps screens

Thirty styles of the same four screens (Home, Dashboard, List and Form), ready to paste into Power Apps. Pick a style, choose how you want to hold the data, then copy each block into Power Apps Studio. A sample CSV is included so the screens work with a real SharePoint list too.

If something goes wrong

  • Studio looks frozen after a paste. Large screens take up to a minute. Wait rather than pasting again.
  • "Name isn't valid" for InventoryItems. Add the SharePoint list as a data source first (Data → Add data → SharePoint), or rename the list to InventoryItems.
  • Category or Region shows errors. Those columns must be Single line of text in the list, not Choice.
  • A font error on the Whiteboard or Chalkboard styles. Replace Font.'Patrick Hand' with Font.'Segoe UI'.
  • A delegation warning (blue underline). It's fine for lists under 2,000 rows. Set Settings → General → Data row limit to 2000.
